title: Supreme Court announces court suspension in some areas on Monday, Nov. 23, 2026
summary: The Supreme Court announced that court operations in some areas in the country are suspended on Monday, November 23, 2026.

blocks.text: The Supreme Court announced that court operations in some areas in the country are suspended on Monday, November 23, 2026.
The following are the affected areas:

items: All courts in La Trinidad and Buguias in Benguet - Benguet Day
All courts in Lubuagan, and MCTCs of Balbalan-Pasil and Tinglayan-Tanudan in Kalinga - power interruption
All courts in Tabuk City and MCTC Pinukpuk-Rizal in Kalinga - power interruption
All courts in Tuao; MTC Rizal; MCTC Piat-Sto. Nino in Cagayan - power interruption
First level court in Angono, Rizal - Higantes Festival
MTC Capoocan, Leyte - 109th Founding Anniversary of the Municipality
